ei.title: It is difficult, if not impossible, to define the
ei.subject: 6월 고2 모의고사
ei.lesson: It is difficult, if not impossible, to define the

fullPassage: It is difficult, if not impossible, to define the limits which reason should impose on the desire for wealth; for there is no absolute or definite amount of wealth which will satisfy a man. The amount is always relative, that is to say, just so much as will maintain the proportion between what he wants and what he gets; for to measure a man's happiness only by what he gets, and not also by what he expects to get, is as pointless as to try and express a fraction which shall have a numerator but no denominator. A man never feels the loss of things which it never occurs to him to ask for; he is just as happy without them; whilst another, who may have a hundred times as much, feels miserable because he has not got the one thing he wants. In fact, every man has a horizon of his own, and he will expect as much as he thinks it is possible for him to get.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: what → which: 선행사 the limits를 수식하는 관계대명사 which 필요
det.analysis:
① impossible — 형용사로 'if not impossible'의 보어 역할, 정상 ←오답
② what — 선행사 'the limits'가 있으므로 관계대명사 which가 필요, what은 선행사 포함 관계대명사로 비문 ←정답
③ relative — 형용사로 보어 역할 (The amount is always relative), 정상 ←오답
④ gets — 주어 he(3인칭 단수)에 대한 동사, 정상 ←오답
det.tip: 'the limits which reason should impose'에서 which는 선행사 the limits를 받는 관계대명사입니다. what은 선행사를 포함하므로 이 자리에 올 수 없습니다.

The amount is always relative, that is to say, just so much as ②<u>will maintaining</u> the proportion between what he wants and what he gets; for to measure a man's happiness only by what he gets, and not also by what he ③<u>expects</u> to get, is as pointless as to try and express a fraction which shall have a numerator but no denominator. A man never feels the loss of things which it never ④<u>occurs</u> to him to ask for; he is just as happy without them; whilst another, who may have a hundred times as much, feels miserable because he has not got the one thing he wants. In fact, every man has a horizon of his own, and he will expect as much as he thinks it is possible for him to get.
